subject: Scheduling: Security assurance & procurement prep — Evergreen Systems
messages:
From: Alex Mendez <alex@evergreen.io>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <procurement@evergreen.io>, Evergreen Security <security@evergreen.io>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security assurance call — kickoff and constraints

Hi Logan,

Thanks for the product overview last week. Our security and procurement leads would like to run a short assurance call to validate data handling, logging, and vendor controls before we proceed to procurement. Attendees we expect: myself (platform), Priya (procurement), and two engineers from our SecOps team (cc'd).

Constraints from my side:
- Window: next week (May 10–14)
- Best times: 10:00–13:00 ET or after 16:00 ET
- We will need a brief list of artifacts you can share in advance (SOC2, encryption docs, data retention policy) — 1–2 page summaries preferred.

Can you propose 2 times that work for Redwood and confirm who from your side will join (AE/SE/security)? Also include any pre-read attachments or a checklist so our engineers can pick the right person to attend.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Mendez
Platform Engineering Lead | Evergreen Systems

Attachment: none
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mendez <alex@evergreen.io>
Cc: Priya Desai <procurement@evergreen.io>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security assurance call — kickoff and constraints

Alex — thanks for the clear constraints. Happy to get this scheduled. Proposed attendees from Redwood: myself (AE), Soojin Lee (SE), and Marissa Cole (Security/Compliance).

Two proposed slots that match your windows (all ET):
- Option A: Tue, May 11 at 11:00–11:45 ET (short Q&A + artifacts walk-through)
- Option B: Thu, May 13 at 16:30–17:15 ET (if you prefer outside core hours)

Pre-reads I can share now (attached):
- security-ask-template.md — checklist your team can use to indicate which artifacts they want in full.
- POC-scope.xlsx — quick scope for the POC so SE can align demos with security questions.

If neither slot works, propose times that work for your SecOps folks and we'll accommodate. Priya — looping you for procurement cadence/PO timeline notes.

Cheers,
Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: security-ask-template.md (stub), POC-scope.xlsx (stub)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mendez <alex@evergreen.io>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security assurance call — kickoff and constraints

Hi Alex / Logan —

Quick notes from security:
- We can cover SOC 2 scope, encryption at rest/in transit, key management options (KMS/HSM), network segmentation for Private deployments, and audit log retention.
- I have a one-page evidence index that maps high-level asks to artifacts; attaching redwood-soc2-index.pdf.
- For the call, please confirm whether you need: full SOC2 report, audit logs samples, or just the control mappings. Full reports require an NDA/attestation in place; we can share the index first.

Availability (PST converted to ET in parens):
- Mon May 10: 13:00–16:00 PT (16:00–19:00 ET) — limited
- Tue May 11: 12:00–14:00 PT (15:00–17:00 ET) — good
- Thu May 13: 10:00–12:00 PT (13:00–15:00 ET) — okay

If Tue 11 at 11:00 ET is the preferred slot, I can join at 11:00 ET but would need to wrap by 11:45 ET. Otherwise Tue 11 at 15:00 ET is also doable.

Sooj — can you prepare a 10-minute architecture diagram focused on network boundaries and key lifecycle for the call?

thanks,
Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-soc2-index.pdf (stub)
From: Alex Mendez <alex@evergreen.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <procurement@evergreen.io>, Evergreen Security <security@evergreen.io>
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 14:55:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Security assurance call — kickoff and constraints

Thanks Marissa — that index is helpful. Our SecOps team reviewed and prefers Option A (Tue May 11 at 11:00 ET). Priya has a procurement stand-up at 11:00 ET so she may join late.

For evidence: please start with the control mappings and sample audit log schema. We will escalate to formal SOC2 report request if controls look aligned. Also, we need a short note on data residency defaults for hosted vs private deployment.

Priya — for procurement, can you confirm whether Evergreen requires a PO before a sandbox POC, or whether vendor acceptance + SOW is acceptable?

If everyone confirms, I can accept the invite and send a short attendee list.

Alex

Attachment: none
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mendez <alex@evergreen.io>
Cc: Priya Desai <procurement@evergreen.io>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Evergreen Security <security@evergreen.io>
Date: Mon, 9 May 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmed: Tue May 11 11:00–11:45 ET — Security assurance call (Evergreen)

All — calendar invite sent (calendar-invite.ics attached). Confirming Tue May 11 at 11:00–11:45 ET for the security assurance call. Notes and next steps below: 

Agenda (30–45 minutes):
- 5 min intro (AE)
- 10 min architecture & network boundaries (SE — Soojin)
- 10 min security control mappings & artifact index (Marissa)
- 10–20 min Q&A + procurement checklist / next steps (all)

Pre-reads attached to this thread: redwood-soc2-index.pdf, security-ask-template.md, POC-scope.xlsx. Please flag which artifacts you want in full before the call so we can prepare the right evidence.

Procurement next steps (Priya): if Evergreen prefers PO-first, let us know and we'll draft a scoping SOW + estimated invoice. Otherwise we can proceed on mutual acceptance + SOW for the sandbox POC.

HubSpot: I created a meeting record and linked the deal (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/EVG-4892).

Sooj — can you drop the 2-slide architecture PNG in the shared Drive before the call? Marissa — please be ready to share the one-page evidence index.

Cheers,
Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0192
